item.coloph: ces nye gnas drang srong smon lam rgyal mtshan gyi skyes tshogs gsol 'debs 'di/ gus ldan grwa btsun 'ga' yis bskul ba'i phyir/ me ston nyi ri wer zhi'i (zhis) rgyal ba'i bka' dang rang snang la gsal bzhin mdo tsam sbyar ba'o//
